items.title: Nvidia financing initiative follows SEC guidance that takes sponsors off the hook for data center investments

items.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California

items.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump bid to overturn E. Jean Carroll verdict
items.description: President Trump was held civilly liable in the case by a New York federal jury for defaming and sexually abusing the writer E. Jean Carroll.

items.title: Synchrony, credit card issuer to Amazon and Walmart, partners with OpenAI for ChatGPT shopping

items.title: Oil prices rise as Iran rules out interim deal extension, threatens to escalate conflict

items.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever

items.description: Brockman told CNBC he doesn't think the wave of recent departures at OpenAI are 'actually that atypical.'

items.title: Vista Energy up 4% after billionaire Peter Thiel buys stake in the Argentine shale oil producer

items.description: A falling VIX points to growing investor complacency ahead of a traditionally turbulent time for markets, strategists warn.

items.title: Depleted strategic oil reserve nears level that raises concerns about damage to caverns, operations

items.title: I drove Tesla FSD, Rivian Autonomy+ ‘hands-free’ driving systems. Here’s how they compare

items.title: China's economy slows further in July as retail sales barely grow, investment slump steepens
items.description: The data is reinforcing concerns about the health of the world's second-largest economy, which has grappled with a deepening supply-demand imbalance.

items.title: Ferrari Luce: Polarizing EV becomes a $40 million collector’s item
